# Take a pic

> Photo booth rental in New York featuring an AI robot photographer and a drone that supports a 360° camera. Weddings, corporate events and open-space parties.

## Packages
- Basic: mirror booth, red carpet, 360 camera, no backdrop
- Premium: Basic plus custom backdrop
- Lux: Premium plus AI robot photographer, drone-assisted 360 coverage and magazine-style booth
